name: Reports - Generate, view, and manage reports
description: Verifies report generation including technical reports, delivery records, PDF export, and status tracking

planSteps.description: Assert that reports list loads with type, status, date columns and filter options
Click 'New Report' and select report type (Technical Report, Delivery Record, Inspection Report)
Select an order to associate the report with and verify order data pre-populates
Add report content: observations, recommendations, attachments
Save the report as draft, then submit for review
Assert that report status changes to 'under_review'
Navigate to /dashboard/delivery-records and create a new delivery record with signature capture
Assert that PDF generation is available and the report can be downloaded
